headline: Seagulls And Gunners Split The House
deck: Brighton v Arsenal splits several ties, with test3 and test31121 goalless across the line and test1 eight clear of test2.
body:
One fixture, half the league invested, and no tie neutral by five o'clock. test3 sends Calafiori and Dunk out against Ødegaard, Georginio, Kostoulas and Gabriel of test31121, a head-to-head still locked at nil and every one of them on the same ninety minutes. Whoever gives least away here decides it.

test1 carry an eight-nil cushion over test2 with Saka alone against Rice and Havertz, comfortable until it isn't. testf lead test31 two-nil, De Cuyper the man in front of Verbruggen's goal, one clean sheet either way and the tie tilts. Groß, Hinshelwood and White watch on with nothing riding on them and everything to spoil.
